headline: FBI and USDA systems hit by cyberattacks
standfirst: Major US government departments are dealing with reported security breaches.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The FBI and the USDA were both hacked. The attacks were reported this past Friday.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This is the second time in recent months that the FBI has been targeted by hackers.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The latest FBI breach targeted the National Crime Information Center. This database is used by police.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates on how much data was compromised in these attacks.

caption:
The FBI and the USDA have been hit by cyberattacks according to reports from multiple news outlets.

This marks the second time in just a few months that the FBI has faced a security breach. The most recent incident specifically targeted the National Crime Information Center, a critical database used by law enforcement agencies across the country.
